description.content:
Chainstack-managed RPC node API for the Bitcoin blockchain. Endpoints follow the canonical JSON-RPC over HTTPS interface for the network. Authenticate against your Chainstack node's per-node URL (e.g. https://nd-XXX-XXX-XXX.p2pify.com/<key>). Merged from the Chainstack Developer Portal per-method fragments at https://github.com/chainstack/dev-portal/tree/main/openapi/bitcoin_node_api.

Contact Support:
 Name: Chainstack API Support
 Email: support@chainstack.com
